dispatch_correction.note: The original arm dispatch said 36 44b6 graphs. The root corrected that count before preregistration was committed or predictions ran. This preregistration freezes the authenticated 21-graph 44b6 inventory and fails closed on any 6bba path.

candidate_rule.graph_pattern: Enumerate every observed one-child chain P->C1->G1 in every 44b6 graph. Pair it with every distinct observed one-child chain Q->C2->G2 at the same C1/C2 frame, with P!=Q, then require G1 and G2 each to survive by one further observed edge. P,C1,C2,G1,G2 and the two survival nodes must be distinct.
candidate_rule.persistence: Both proposed branches must be observed through daughter, grandchild, and one further successor. Every edge in each observed chain must be a one-frame edge and every internal branch node must have exactly one observed predecessor and successor.
candidate_rule.label_blind_locality: Let R be the per-video p95 Euclidean length of all observed one-frame edges, computed from baseline graph coordinates only. Require ||P-C2||<=R, ||C1-C2||<=R, and ||C1-G2||<=R.
candidate_rule.mutual_uniqueness: Rank eligible alternatives by the sum of the three locality distances divided by max(R,1e-12). Keep only mutual best P<->C2 pairs for which each finite runner-up cost is at least 1.25 times its best cost.
candidate_rule.late_fork_equivalence: Emit scorer-semantic D1 at the next frame: C1 is the late parent and G1,G2 are its children. Preserve/re-add C1->G1, replace C2->G2 by C1->G2, and own exactly all observed outgoing edges of C1 plus all observed incoming edges of G1 and G2.
candidate_rule.candidate_key: sha256(identity, observed P node, sorted observed G1/G2 terminal nodes)
candidate_rule.confidence_order: descending minimum observed branch survival depth, then descending mutual-best margin, then ascending normalized locality cost, then candidate_key

suppression.selection: Greedily accept confidence-ordered candidates only when no occupied node has been accepted before.

evaluation.pass: combined_score_delta > 0 AND division_jaccard >= 0.30 AND adjusted_edge_jaccard_delta >= 0 AND raw_edge_jaccard_delta >= 0 AND node_recall_delta >= 0 AND duplicate_survivors == 0
